outcome: Proteomic cargo of syncytiotrophoblast-derived extracellular vesicles (STBEVs)
cohort: Placentae were collected from nine patients (4 with GDM and 5 with normal pregnancies) in a UK-based cohort, all with gestational ages of 38-40 weeks.
finding: Fifty-six proteins were differentially expressed in medium/large syncytiotrophoblast-derived extracellular vesicles (m/lSTBEVs) from GDM placentae compared to normal placentae, with positive regulation of cytoskeleton organisation identified as the most significantly enriched biological process.
cross-section timing: Placentae were isolated ex vivo following delivery from pregnancies at 38-40 weeks gestational age.
